author: Deric Jackman
title: Indie animation team hiring character pose artist
content: Expanding our team! We’re looking for an artist who can replicate our style & trace/develop 15 character poses at a rate of $250USD for the promotional package. We would link you up with a shading/lighting director & our art team. Drop some of your work below! #IndieAnimation Follow-up: We’ve recruited a superstar team & we’re actively searching for fresh talent. We review your responses, but something that will enhance your odds of recruitment is if you can show us some of your work. Please show us your work in your response to this thread. Contact: reply on the thread with portfolio samples.

author: The Kelvingrove Review
title: Paid cover art commission for academic journal
content: WHAT DOES CONFLICT LOOK LIKE? £250 paid commission. Deadline: 1 November 2026. A4 | Two pieces, or one design that can be split across both covers. Conflict does not exist only in words. It lives in images: the things we see become the enduring afterlife of "passed" moments. Thread: For our upcoming issue, “Art in Times of Conflict,” we’re looking for an artist or designer to create our front and back cover. To apply, email kelvingrovereview@glasgow.ac.uk with: a brief bio; a description of your proposed work and its inspiration; a short portfolio (3 previous works). You do not need to create the cover art before applying. The use of Generative AI is strictly prohibited, all art must be original.
